cover: Political Shakeups in Washington, Global Tech Stocks Plunge, and a South American Resignation
cover_scene: A split composition showing a glowing Capitol dome on one side and a red financial ticker plunging over global city skylines on the other side.

slides.scene: A grand mahogany executive office framed by American flags and presidential seals, lit by soft interior lamps.
slides.headline: Stephen Miller Named White House Chief of Staff
slides.body: U.S. President Donald Trump appointed senior adviser Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff following Republican midterm losses. Miller replaces Susie Wiles as the administration recalibrates its legislative agenda and executive leadership moving forward.

slides.scene: A quiet government plaza at dusk before a illuminated presidential palace, Paraguayan flags fluttering on poles under a moody sky.
slides.headline: Paraguay President Santiago Peña Resigns After Banking Crisis
slides.body: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña stepped down following a political crisis triggered by the Ueno Bank collapse. Constitutional successors are navigating the government transition while Congress considers formal proceedings.

slides.scene: Riot police with shields standing outside a massive modern technological facility at dusk under dramatic stormy light.
slides.headline: Protesters Breach Microsoft Data Center Construction in Amsterdam
slides.body: Demonstrators breached the perimeter of a Microsoft data center construction site in the Netherlands, drawing a heavy riot police response. European data center projects face growing public resistance over heavy energy and water consumption.

slides.scene: A modern Asian financial exchange floor surrounded by large digital screens glowing red with falling stock charts.
slides.headline: Asian Markets Plunge Following Global Tech Sell-Off
slides.body: Major Asian stock indices fell sharply as fallout from Wall Street hit regional markets. Shares of major tech firms including SK Hynix, Samsung, and TSMC dropped significantly amid growing investor concern over artificial intelligence infrastructure costs.

slides.scene: A dark wooden courtroom desk with a wooden gavel resting beside scales of justice, soft light casting long shadows.
slides.headline: Nigerian Court Disqualifies Key Opposition Candidate Before Election
slides.body: A Nigerian court barred a prominent opposition candidate from competing in the upcoming presidential election. The ruling reshapes the political landscape just months before voters head to the polls.
